security.summary: Provider name rendered as React text; HTTPS bounded image with no-referrer; auth/OneTap/staff and logout callback retained; no secrets or new reads/mutations.

code_quality.summary: Historical checkpoint, retrospectively recorded: scoped mobile nav/state/bounds defects required fixes before handoff; not a pre-fix source snapshot.

failure_paths.summary: Fixture verifies missing/failed photo, missing/long name, signed-out/UID change, mobile overlays and pending/failed logout; no provider success claim.

error_handling.summary: Image falls back to initials; existing parent logout error feedback preserved; pending action disabled; links close/navigation and Escape focus verified.

production_readiness.summary: Deployment impact inspected; no API/config/migrations/dependencies/release change. Local build passes. Full production/live provider acceptance NOT_READY; manual review is not authenticated release approval.

trade_offs.summary: Shared public-UX WIP retained; narrow signed-in mobile request CTA hidden in favor of duplicate menu destination. Current source hashes and synthetic fixture evidence bound; full screen-reader/cross-browser/zoom not certified.

findings.summary: Inherited main-nav styles hide nested account links on mobile.
Profile key tied to mobile menu state resets opening on account activation.

residual_risks: Shared worktree contains concurrent public-UX modifications; this is scoped manual UI review only.
Full production readiness remains NOT_READY; live auth/logout not tested here.
